purpose: Standalone creative/silly image prompts for Gemini — not tied to any quote. Intended for splash screens, loading states, Easter eggs, shareable bonus cards, app decor. Each entry feeds scripts/build-silly-prompts.mjs to produce ready-to-paste prompt blocks in gemini_silly_prompts.md.

entries.title: Mall Santa
entries.scene: dressed as a red-velvet mall Santa on a gift-wrapped throne, a small child on his lap looks genuinely alarmed mid-photo, a line of tired parents waits behind a velvet rope, tinsel and fake snow everywhere, fluorescent mall lighting

entries.title: Beekeeper
entries.scene: in a full white beekeeper suit with the veil thrown back, calmly holding a honeycomb frame covered in thousands of bees, sunny orchard, at least one bee on the tip of his nose

entries.title: Yoga instructor
entries.scene: in yoga clothes leading a class of confused elderly seniors in a warrior pose, bright airy studio with wood floors, house plants everywhere, his expression is deadly serious

entries.title: Conveyor sushi chef
entries.scene: in a white chef coat and headband behind a conveyor-belt sushi counter, placing a plate of nigiri onto the belt with perfect ceremony, bright Tokyo-diner lighting, a child diner staring wide-eyed

entries.title: Lawn gnome
entries.scene: as a ceramic garden gnome standing motionless among flowerbeds in a suburban lawn, red pointed hat, blue coat, white beard, his face is unmistakably alert and watchful, a squirrel regards him suspiciously

entries.title: Wax museum figure
entries.scene: standing perfectly still as a wax-museum figure on a velvet-roped pedestal, nameplate reads 'WALKEN', two tourists taking a selfie beside him, neither notices he is real, museum spotlighting

entries.title: Flight attendant safety demo
entries.scene: in a navy flight-attendant uniform demonstrating the oxygen-mask safety procedure in a crowded airplane aisle, holding the yellow mask to his face with intense solemnity, bored passengers ignoring him

entries.title: Sportscaster
entries.scene: at a glossy sports-anchor desk in a pressed suit, holding a coffee mug, animated highlight graphics frozen behind him on the video wall, teleprompter mid-sentence

entries.title: Lighthouse keeper in storm
entries.scene: as a grizzled lighthouse keeper in a yellow slicker battling wind and sea spray on a rocky outcrop, the lighthouse beam cutting through driving rain behind him, waves crashing, single lantern in hand

entries.title: Ice skating coach
entries.scene: in a tracksuit and whistle on indoor ice, arms crossed, watching a wobbly child skater, rink lighting, other skaters going past, his expression is quietly horrified

entries.title: Grand Canyon guide
entries.scene: as a park-ranger tour guide in khaki uniform gesturing toward the vast Grand Canyon panorama, small group of tourists listening, golden hour, massive canyon layers in background

entries.title: Weather forecaster
entries.scene: in a blazer standing in front of a bright green weather-map display, pointing at a massive cartoon storm cloud labeled 'WALKENADO', studio lighting, earpiece visible

entries.title: Balloon-animal artist
entries.scene: at a child's birthday party in a vest and bow tie, twisting a balloon dog with enormous focus, terrified birthday child staring up at him, pastel party decorations everywhere

entries.title: Park chess master
entries.scene: on a weathered park bench in Washington Square Park mid-chess-game against a smug teenager, concrete chess tables, a small crowd watching, his hand hovering over the queen

entries.title: Subway busker
entries.scene: playing a small keyboard on the subway platform in a trenchcoat, open keyboard case with scattered dollar bills, commuters rushing past, one elderly woman pausing to listen, fluorescent platform lighting

entries.title: The Walken — tarot card
entries.scene: illustrated as a full tarot card labeled 'THE WALKEN' at the bottom in elegant serif type, ornate gold-leaf border, 1920s occult art-deco style, he holds a lantern in one hand and a rose in the other, faint cosmic stars behind

entries.title: Renaissance oil with pear
entries.scene: painted as a formal 17th-century Dutch oil portrait, dark velvet cloak, white lace collar, holding a single ripe pear in one gloved hand, dramatic chiaroscuro, heavy gold-leaf frame implied at the edges

entries.title: Stained glass saint
entries.scene: rendered as a medieval cathedral stained-glass window panel, halo behind his head, robes in deep blues and reds, tiny walking cane in one hand, sunlight streaming through the colored glass

entries.title: Claymation music video
entries.scene: as a stop-motion claymation figure in a surreal 90s music-video set, everything around him made of clay — clay TV, clay couch, clay flowers — he is mid-dance move, obvious fingerprint textures, claymation lighting

entries.title: 16-bit pixel sprite
entries.scene: rendered as a 16-bit SNES-era RPG character sprite on a tiled grass-and-cobblestone background, clearly visible individual pixels, a small dialogue box at the bottom reads 'WALKEN approaches.', retro-videogame aesthetic

entries.title: Low-poly PS1 render
entries.scene: as a low-polygon 1998-PlayStation-era 3D character model, sharply angular face, visibly blocky hands, flat-shaded low-res textures, standing in a vaporwave grid-floor environment, early-3D-graphics aesthetic

entries.title: Illuminated manuscript
entries.scene: painted in the margins of a medieval illuminated manuscript, gold leaf and Latin-script Lorem Ipsum text around him, he is holding a tiny walking-cane and a snail, vellum-yellow page, crimson and blue pigments

entries.title: Sumi-e ink painting
entries.scene: rendered as a traditional Japanese sumi-e ink-wash painting on aged rice paper, confident black brush strokes, minimal palette, he stands under a single gnarled pine tree, red seal chop stamp in the corner

entries.title: Paleolithic cave painting
entries.scene: rendered as an ancient cave painting on a rough stone wall, ochre-and-charcoal pigments, his recognizable silhouette striding alongside stick-figure mammoths and hand prints, torchlight glow on the stone

entries.title: Pop-art silkscreen grid
entries.scene: replicated in a four-panel pop-art silkscreen grid, each panel tinted differently — hot pink, electric yellow, lime green, cyan — same pose in each cell, thick black ink outlines, 1960s silkscreen-print aesthetic

entries.title: Children's picture book
entries.scene: illustrated as a friendly character in a hand-painted children's picture book, gentle watercolor style, walking through a storybook forest with a rabbit at his heels and a giant moon overhead, text-free page

entries.title: Neon storefront sign
entries.scene: depicted as a glowing neon sign outside a rain-slicked 1980s diner, pink-and-blue tubing forming his unmistakable silhouette, reflections in wet pavement, steam rising from a manhole

entries.title: Egyptian pharaoh
entries.scene: as an Egyptian pharaoh on a golden throne in a torchlit temple, blue-and-gold striped nemes headdress, crook and flail crossed over his chest, hieroglyphs carved into the wall behind him, two sphinx statues flanking the throne

entries.title: Samurai
entries.scene: as a samurai in full black-and-gold armor on a misty mountaintop at dawn, katana drawn and pointed downward, cherry blossoms drifting across the frame, traditional Edo-period costume, distant pagoda

entries.title: Saloon cowboy
entries.scene: as a lean Old West gunslinger in a dusty saloon at high noon, wide-brim hat pulled low, long coat, hand hovering over holstered revolver, piano man frozen mid-note in the background, shafts of sunlight through wooden slats

entries.title: Viking longship captain
entries.scene: as a Viking chieftain at the prow of a longship carving through stormy North-Atlantic seas, horned helmet (inaccurate but iconic), braided beard, fur-lined cloak whipping in the wind, crew rowing behind him

entries.title: Medieval knight
entries.scene: as a medieval knight in full polished plate armor, visor raised, kneeling on one knee in a stone cathedral before a sword laid on an altar, stained-glass light falling across his face

entries.title: Roman senator
entries.scene: as a Roman senator in a toga with a laurel wreath, standing at a marble rostrum in a sunlit forum, arm outstretched mid-oration, other senators listening from stone benches

entries.title: Victorian detective
entries.scene: as a Victorian-era detective in a long dark overcoat and tweed cap, gas lamp illuminating his gaunt features, holding a magnifying glass up to an ornate doorknob, cobblestone London street, thick fog

entries.title: 1920s speakeasy patron
entries.scene: as a sharply dressed 1920s speakeasy regular at a small corner table, pinstripe suit, fedora tilted low, a glass of amber liquor in hand, smoky jazz-age lounge, dim beaded-lamp light

entries.title: Cooking class teacher
entries.scene: teaching a home-kitchen cooking class in an apron, smiling warmly as he shows a small group of students how to fold dumplings, flour everywhere, morning sunlight through the window, chalkboard menu behind him

entries.title: Fireplace reading
entries.scene: curled in a deep armchair by a crackling fireplace reading a well-worn hardcover book, a sleeping tabby cat draped across his lap, mug of tea on the side table, soft golden light, snowing outside the window

entries.title: Tomato-greenhouse gardener
entries.scene: in a canvas apron and wide-brimmed sunhat watering ripe tomato plants in a glass greenhouse, dappled sunlight streaming through the panes, gardening shears in his belt, content expression

entries.title: Calligraphy teacher
entries.scene: patiently showing a young student how to hold a dip pen at a sunlit wooden desk, ink bottles and practice sheets spread around, soft-focus bookshelf background, both of them concentrating

entries.title: Duck pond
entries.scene: on a park bench by a glassy pond feeding a flock of friendly ducks from a paper bag of crumbs, one duck boldly stepping onto his shoe, autumn leaves on the water, early-morning golden light

entries.title: Pie at the window
entries.scene: placing a freshly baked lattice-top fruit pie on a farmhouse kitchen window sill to cool, warm late-afternoon sunlight, gingham curtains, flour dusted on his apron, a bluebird watching from a nearby branch

entries.title: Pigeon snowglobe
entries.scene: standing inside a massive snowglobe filled with floating pigeons instead of snowflakes, his hand pressed against the curved glass from within, a giant hand visible outside shaking the globe, dreamlike lighting

entries.title: Melting-clock desert
entries.scene: in a flat orange-gold Dalí-esque desert, a melting pocketwatch draped over his shoulder like a scarf, other melting clocks across the horizon, elongated shadow stretching far behind him, dreamlike surrealism

entries.title: Disobedient shadow
entries.scene: standing on an empty cobblestone plaza at sunset while his own long shadow is visibly walking in a completely different direction, the shadow waving back at him, uncanny lighting, deep magenta sky

entries.title: Mirror hall
entries.scene: standing in a hall of hundreds of small antique mirrors of varying sizes, every reflection showing him doing a slightly different action — waving, drinking coffee, reading — only the central real him stands still
